method: per-criterion median across three judges, then weighted by the rubric

notes.problem: Lower half mid-tone brown; dull dark planks with no focal; the gutter band a grey middle.
notes.fix: Drop the gutter and kerb albedo to black and tilt up so the gutter leaves the frame, leaving the chamfers and panel as the only lights.

notes.problem: Darkened tops read as brown planks; the stop bar and panel outshine the paint; a mid-brown kerb plane; a stair-stepped shadow edge; a scrim behind the claim line.
notes.fix: Restore bead-white tops raked only on the chamfers; raise the eye to about 0.5 m and pitch down so the bars fill y 900 to 1800; double the sun shadow map.

notes.problem: Broad brown mid-tone plank tops, no single subject; the panel does not show removal directed.
notes.fix: Drop the top albedo so only chamfers catch the key; dolly low over the panel so it owns the lower left third.

notes.problem: The field bleeds both edges as wallpaper; far rows as bright as near; the legend can't be checked.
notes.fix: Pull back so the whole block sits inside a dark margin; stage the light on the front rows.

notes.problem: Boxy markers with navy-black prism faces; a uniform tan pattern at 432; small amber markers above the claim line.
notes.fix: Warm reflective prism insets; eye about 0.6 m at fov 28 so the amber row stands about 25 percent up at twice the size.

notes.problem: The field bleeds both edges at even brightness, wallpaper; the legend can't be checked.
notes.fix: Pull back so the block sits inside with a dark margin; pool the key on the front rows and the amber markers.

notes.problem: Evenly lit grooves, a vent grille; rows 2 and 3 indented leave a dead block under the start bar.
notes.fix: Pool the key on the start bar and row 1; shift rows 2 and 3 left to start at the start bar.

notes.problem: A flat evenly lit rectangle reading as a vent grille.
notes.fix: Tighten the pool on the start bar and row 1; a lit top arris on the strip.

notes.problem: A flat evenly lit rectangle of grooves, a vent grille; CERTIFIED floats above the strip.
notes.fix: Tighten the pool on the start bar and row 1; set CERTIFIED beside the start bar with a leader.

notes.problem: A two-bar chart on a uniformly lit grey band, no pool or falloff.
notes.fix: A keyMask pool on the bar ends and the 55 to 70 ticks, the pan falling to black at its edges; raise the bars for long casts.

notes.problem: An embossed bar chart on a stucco plate; the bars share the concrete's noise; a hard-edged band with dead black above and below.
notes.fix: A smooth bead-glint height field for the bars; extend the pan to y 760 to 1760 with the pool falling off.

notes.problem: A primitive body, flat black windshield, the hard ground edge.
notes.fix: Extend the ground under the fog; an environment reflection in the windshield.

notes.problem: A primitive car body, flat black windshield, blank plate.
notes.fix: An environment reflection in the glass, a warm rim, the headlight throw on a fictional plate.

notes.problem: Flat quads with a thin lip and no visible cast; a near-black void upper left.
notes.fix: Bevelled 7 mm bars with soft casts; swing about 8 degrees left and lower the eye so the crosswalks fill the width.

rounds_source: this module's own log of cards it has scored

craft_note: at the round cap the craft floor stands down. The art median 6.8 is under 8.5 and the deck ships as it is. Name it in the run record
